paragraphs: See the entry Rav Yosef bar Abba.[^1]

notes.text: The heading gives Yosei with bar Abba—bar Abbahu; the target gives Yosef bar Abba. The dash and alternative patronymic are preserved without deciding whether they indicate variants or distinct people. The heading was recorded as provisional; both Rav titles are explicit.
